subject: Daz
fact: Daz has found purpose as the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard.
source_quote: He has found purpose. He is the feared mage of the Ember Vanguard!

subject: direction change
fact: Thorin leads the group west instead of south, where the Empty Scabbard Killers live.
source_quote: Thorin leads them west, instead of south, where the Empty Scabbard Killers live.

subject: Grygum yelped
fact: Thorin hears a yelp from Grygum.

subject: Trapper
fact: A creature that looks like a manta ray envelops Grygum.
source_quote: sees Grygum enveloped by a creature that looks like a manta ray.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz ponders his spell list and considers Magic Missile the best bet.
source_quote: Daz ponders his spell list and has some intriguing ideas, but realizes that the old standby, Magic Missile, is probably the best bet.

subject: Zalthir and Thorin attack creature
fact: Zalthir and Thorin attack the creature to get it to release Grygum.
source_quote: Zalthir and Thorin attack the creature, trying to get it to release Grygum.

subject: Daz casts silvery barbs
fact: Daz casts silvery barbs to help Grygum escape.
source_quote: So he casts silvery barbs to help Grygum escape

subject: Daz casts toll the dead
source_quote: and then Daz follows up with the deadly chimes of the spell toll the dead.

subject: Zalthir strikes creature
fact: Zalthir strikes the creature a few more times with his fist.
source_quote: Zalthir strikes the creature a few more times with his fist

subject: Trapper
fact: The creature dies before Grygum can take advantage of the spell.
source_quote: the beast dies before Grygum can take advantage of the spell.

subject: Grygum is covered in acid slime
fact: Grygum is covered in the acid slime of the Trapper.
source_quote: he is covered in the acid slime of the Trapper.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum is grateful but looks unhappy.
source_quote: But the Orc is grateful, but he looks unhappy

fact: The session date is Diirdeklin the Derro.
